_schema._about: Content for /404 (dist/404/index.html, also served for any unmatched route by vercel.json). A short black page: eyebrow, display h1, one paragraph, the filled Book-a-call button (data-cta="404") and a row of four text links. No drawing or image. British English.

_schema.hero: {eyebrow, h1, p, primary:{label, href}, links:[{label, href}]} - primary is the booking button; links are plain text.
